questions.stem: In a group of 2000 people, 1% are infected. Of the infected people, 90% test positive. How many infected people test positive?
questions.explain: 1% of 2000 is 20 infected. Then 90% of 20 is 18.

questions.stem: A box has 4 red and 6 blue balls. In how many ways can you pick 1 red ball and 1 blue ball?
questions.explain: The two choices are independent and multiply: 4 × 6 = 24.
